title: Doozy Vape Co Lush E-Liquid 10ml
description: Lush by Doozy Vape Co. is an absolutely irresistible blend of fruit and dessert, with a fresh, sweet layer of juicy strawberries riding above a sumptuous base of rich, clotted cream. The 70% Vegetable Glycerine, 30% Propylene Glycol formula makes this eliquid ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing mighty clouds on top of fantastic flavour and a smooth, comfortable, throat hit. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits .
